items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the business corporation law, in relation to design professional service corporations
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S7378

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the business corporation law, in relation to design
professional service corporations

PURPOSE:
To give the State Education department the authority to approve the
conversion of a professional service corporation, that was in
existence prior to the enactment of Chapter 550 of the Laws of 2011,
to a design professional service corporation.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
Section 1 gives the State Education Department the authority to
approve the conversion of a professional service corporation, that
was in existence prior to the enactment of Chapter 550 of the Laws of
2011, to a design professional service corporation.

JUSTIFICATION:
Chapter 550 of the Laws of 2011 authorized a new type of professional
service corporation to be known as a design professional service
corporation. Under prior law, professional service corporations in
New York restricted ownership to design professionals licensed
pursuant to education law. Specifically, these professions included
professional engineering, architecture, landscape architecture and
land surveying. Chapter 550 granted design firms the flexibility of
offering an ownership interest in the corporation to non-licensees
via the design professional service corporation. That chapter also
required that greater than 75% of the directors and officers be
licensed design professionals and that the largest single shareholder
be a design professional.

Unfortunately, that law failed to provide for the conversion of an
existing professional service corporation to a design professional
service corporation. This bill would give the State Education
Department the authority to approve such conversions and would bring
the law in line with the intent of Chapter 550.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New legislation.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None to the State.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the business corporation law, in relation to design professional service corporations
A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S7378A

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the business corporation law, in relation to design
professional service corporations

PURPOSE:
To clarify the law regarding design professional services corporations
by allowing professional corporations (P.C.'s) to convert to design
professional service corporations (D.P.C's) without having to create
a separate corporation while converting from the original corporation.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
Section 1503 of the business corporation law is amended by adding a
new paragraph (b-5) to allow an existing professional service
corporation to convert to a design professional service corporation.

JUSTIFICATION:
Chapter 550 of the Laws of 2011 created a new type of professional
corporation-a design professional service corporation or D.P.C. Under
this new law, design firms are given the option of offering an
ownership interest in the corporation to non-licensed employees
through an Employee Stock Ownership Olan (ESOP). However, it has
become unclear whether or not professional corporations wishing to
offer this ESOP can easily transition to D.P.C's without the need to
reincorporate as a new entity. This amendment will clarify the
conversion process for professional corporations by allowing
corporations in good standing to simply convert to D.P.C's.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New legislation.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None to the State.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

summary: Allows a professional service corporation, in good standing, to convert to a design professional service corporation if it meets all stated requirements to become a design professional service corporation.
